title: 第6章 想收拾我林墨？没门！
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那根手臂粗的长板，夹杂着恶风，对着林墨的后背，狠狠砸了下来！

这一下要是挨实了，屁股开花都是轻的，怕是脊椎骨都得断掉。

林墨心里把赵德全的祖宗十八代，都狠狠问候了一遍。

他娘的，老子刚从鬼门关爬回来，难道又要被这狗东西给送回去？

就在这千钧一发之际。

“砰！”

一声震耳欲聋的巨响，太医院那扇厚重的木门，竟被人从外面，一脚踹得四分五裂！

木屑纷飞中，一道火红色的身影，猛冲了进来。

正是禁军统领，冷月！

她看都没看呆若木鸡的赵德全。

身形一晃，便已到了跟前。对着那个高举长板，正要行凶的太监，抬腿就是一脚。

“呃啊！”

那太监一声惨叫，整个人就像个破麻袋一样，倒飞出去七八米远。

狠狠撞在墙上，疼得龇牙咧嘴。

现场瞬间陷入一片死寂。

所有人都被这突如其来的一幕，给吓傻了。

一个个张大了嘴巴，目瞪口呆。

冷月俏脸含霜，环视一周。

最后，她的目光，落在了林墨身上。

随即声音清冷地宣读道：“陛下口谕！”

“太医院太医林墨，医术精湛，思虑缜密，于国有功！”

“特擢升为太医院正六品院丞！”

“赏银千两，锦缎百匹！”

“另，为方便其为皇后调理凤体，从即日起，林墨免除太医院当值，擢为凤仪宫专属太医。”

“一应事务，直接对皇后负责！”

“钦此！”

口谕念完，整个院子里，几乎落针可闻。

正六品院丞？

凤仪宫专属太医？

直接对皇后负责？

所有人都懵了，他们不可思议地盯着那个还被按在长凳上的林墨。

一个个眼珠子瞪得溜圆，脸上的表情，跟活吞了一只苍蝇似的。

前一秒，这小子还是个，马上就要被乱棍打死的阶下囚。

下一秒，怎么就成了，皇帝皇后跟前的大红人？！

这反转也太快了！

赵德全更是如遭雷击，整个人都傻了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The arm-thick long board, mixed with the evil wind, hit Lin Mo's back hard!

If it hits hard this time, the swelling on the buttocks will be light, and the spine may be broken.

Lin Mo greeted all the eighteen generations of Zhao Dequan's ancestors in his heart.

Damn it, I just crawled back from the hell gate, am I going to be sent back by this bitch again?

At this critical moment.

"Bang!"

With a deafening bang, the heavy wooden door of the Taiyuan Hospital was kicked to pieces from the outside!

Amidst the flying wood chips, a fiery red figure rushed in.

It’s none other than the commander of the Forbidden Army, Leng Yue!

She didn't even look at Zhao Dequan, who was stunned.

In a flash, he was already in front of him.Aiming at the eunuch who was holding the long board high and about to commit an attack, he raised his leg and kicked it.

"Uh-huh!"

The eunuch screamed and flew backwards seven or eight meters like a broken sack.

He hit the wall hard, grinning in pain.

The scene fell into dead silence for an instant.

Everyone was frightened by this sudden scene.

Everyone opened their mouths and were stunned.

Leng Yue's pretty face was filled with frost, and she looked around.

Finally, her eyes fell on Lin Mo.

Then a cold voice read out: "Your Majesty's oral decree!"

"Lin Mo, the Imperial Physician of the Imperial Hospital, has superb medical skills, thoughtful thinking, and has made great contributions to the country!"

"Specially promoted to the rank of Prime Minister of the Imperial Medical College!"

"Reward a thousand taels of silver and a hundred pieces of brocade!"

"In addition, in order to facilitate the conditioning of the Queen's body, Lin Mo will be exempted from duty at the Imperial Hospital from now on and promoted to be the exclusive Imperial Physician of Fengyi Palace."

"In response to affairs, I will be directly responsible to the queen!"

"Appreciate this!"

After the oral instructions were recited, one could almost hear a needle drop in the whole courtyard.

The sixth grade Yuan Cheng?

Fengyi Palace’s exclusive physician?

Directly responsible to the queen?

Everyone was stunned. They stared in disbelief at Lin Mo, who was still pressed on the bench.

Every eyeball was wide open, and the expression on his face was as if he had swallowed a fly alive.

One second ago, this kid was a prisoner who was about to be beaten to death with random sticks.

The next second, how could he become a famous person in front of the emperor and empress?!

This reversal is too fast!

Zhao Dequan felt as if he had been struck by lightning, and he was completely stunned.
